headlines.title_en: A-share market close: Shenzhen Component Index and ChiNext both rise over 1%, real estate and consumer stocks rally
headlines.summary_en: 1. The Shanghai index fluctuated narrowly throughout the day, while the Shenzhen Component Index and ChiNext Index both rose over 1%. Consumer stocks rallied broadly, with Yiming Food hitting a 3-day limit-up, and stocks such as Jinshiyuan and Anji Food also limit-up. The real estate sector moved higher, with Jingtou Development hitting a 3-day limit-up, and Binjiang Group, Seazen Holdings, and others limit-up. Computing hardware stocks rebounded, with stocks like Focuslight, Sunway Communication, and Yongding Co. hitting limit-up. More stocks rose than fell, with over 4,100 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets trading higher; today's turnover was 2.17 trillion yuan. At close, the Shanghai index rose 0.32%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.09%, and the ChiNext Index rose 1.49%. 2. In terms of sectors and concepts, real estate, consumer, computing hardware, and semiconductor chip sectors led gains, while oil, coal, beauty care, and banking sectors fell against the trend. 3. Across the two markets, 3,860 stocks rose, 95 hit limit-up, 1,217 fell, none hit limit-down, and 11 stocks broke their limit-up.

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title_en: Tencent Holdings: FinTech and enterprise services revenue rose 9% year-on-year to RMB 60.3 billion in Q2
headlines.summary_en: Tencent Holdings: Financial Technology and Enterprise Services business revenue for Q2 2026 increased 9% year-on-year to RMB 60.3 billion. Growth in FinTech services revenue was mainly driven by higher revenue from commercial payments, wealth management, and consumer loan services. Growth in enterprise services revenue was driven by growth in our cloud services revenue, benefiting from rising demand for AI-related services, continued international market expansion, and a more favorable pricing environment.

headlines.title_en: Tencent Holdings: FinTech and enterprise services revenue up 9% year-on-year in Q2 2026
headlines.summary_en: Tencent Holdings (00700.HK) announced that revenue from its Financial Technology and Enterprise Services business for Q2 2026 rose 9% year-on-year to RMB 60.3 billion. Growth in FinTech services revenue was mainly due to increased revenue from commercial payments, wealth management, and consumer loan services. Enterprise services revenue growth was driven by our cloud services revenue growth, supported by rising demand for AI-related services, continued international expansion, and a more favorable pricing environment.

headlines.title: 中国汽车工业协会：新能源汽车月度新车销量占比首超60%
headlines.summary: 中国汽车工业协会12日发布数据显示，2026年7月份，新能源汽车月度新车销量占比首次超过60%、累计占比首次超过50%；月度出口量连续两个月突破100万辆，新能源汽车出口占比连续两个月超过50%。前7个月，我国汽车产销分别完成1756.7万辆和1760.2万辆，其中新能源汽车产销分别完成901.4万辆和900.7万辆，同比增长均近10%。7月，新能源汽车产销分别完成157.6万辆和156.1万辆，同比分别增长26.8%和23.7%，纯电动汽车产销量均超过100万辆，同比增长均超过三成。

headlines.title_en: China Association of Automobile Manufacturers: monthly new energy vehicle sales as a share of new car sales exceeds 60% for the first time
headlines.summary_en: Data released by the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers on the 12th showed that in July 2026, new energy vehicles' monthly share of new car sales exceeded 60% for the first time, and the cumulative share exceeded 50% for the first time; monthly exports surpassed 1 million units for two consecutive months, with NEV exports accounting for over 50% for two consecutive months. In the first seven months, China's auto production and sales reached 17.567 million and 17.602 million units, respectively, with NEV production and sales at 9.014 million and 9.007 million units, both up nearly 10% year-on-year. In July, NEV production and sales were 1.576 million and 1.561 million units, up 26.8% and 23.7% year-on-year, with pure electric vehicle production and sales both exceeding 1 million units, up over 30% year-on-year.

headlines.title: 连续两个月突破100万辆 我国汽车出口延续强劲增长态势
headlines.summary: 从中国汽车工业协会获悉，7月份我国汽车出口表现亮眼，延续强劲增长态势。最新发布的数据显示，今年7月份，汽车出口104.3万辆，环比增长0.6%，同比增长81.3%。其中，新能源汽车出口55.3万辆，环比增长5.7%，同比增长145.5%。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Exports of Chinese automobiles exceed one million vehicles for two consecutive months, sustaining robust growth momentum
headlines.summary_en: According to the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, China's auto exports in July performed strongly, continuing robust growth momentum. Latest data show that in July this year, auto exports reached 1.043 million units, up 0.6% month-on-month and 81.3% year-on-year. Among them, new energy vehicle exports were 553,000 units, up 5.7% month-on-month and 145.5% year-on-year. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 腾讯控股：若剔除算力采购的预付款项，2026年Q2的自由现金流为人民币376亿元
headlines.summary: 腾讯控股公告，二零二六年第二季，本集团录得负自由现金流人民币138亿元，此乃由于经营活动所产生的现金净额人民币527亿元，被资本开支付款人民币593亿元、媒体内容付款人民币50亿元及租赁负债付款人民币22亿元超额抵销。我们的经营现金流包括大额AI相关预付款项，用于提供基础设施以支持Hy模型升级、WorkBuddy及CodeBuddy推理的需求、微信AI举措，以及我们各项产品与服务的AI能力建设，同时满足外部客户对我们的云服务持续增长的需求。若剔除算力采购的预付款项，我们的自由现金流为人民币376亿元。

headlines.title_en: Tencent Holdings: Excluding prepayments for computing power procurement, Q2 2026 free cash flow was RMB 37.6 billion
headlines.summary_en: Tencent Holdings announced that in Q2 2026, the Group recorded negative free cash flow of RMB 13.8 billion, as net cash generated from operating activities of RMB 52.7 billion was more than offset by capital expenditure payments of RMB 59.3 billion, media content payments of RMB 5 billion, and lease liability payments of RMB 2.2 billion. Our operating cash flow includes significant AI-related prepayments to provide infrastructure to support demand for Hy model upgrades, WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy inference needs, WeChat AI initiatives, and AI capability building across our various products and services, while also meeting continued growth in external customer demand for our cloud services. Excluding prepayments for computing power procurement, our free cash flow was RMB 37.6 billion.

headlines.title: 合肥城建：全资子公司工业科技拟发行不超过8亿元中期票据
headlines.summary: 合肥城建公告，公司第八届董事会第三十八次会议审议通过《关于全资子公司拟发行中期票据的议案》，公司全资子公司工业科技拟发行总额不超过人民币8亿元（含8亿元）、期限不超过3年（含3年）的中期票据，募集资金主要用于偿还有息债务、补充流动资金、项目建设等。该议案尚需提交公司2026年第二次临时股东会审议。

headlines.title_en: Hefei Urban Construction: Wholly-owned subsidiary Industrial Technology plans to issue medium-term notes of up to RMB 800 million
headlines.summary_en: Hefei Urban Construction announced that its 38th Board of Directors meeting approved a resolution on a wholly-owned subsidiary issuing medium-term notes. The subsidiary, Industrial Technology, plans to issue medium-term notes totaling no more than RMB 800 million (inclusive) with a term of no more than 3 years (inclusive), with proceeds mainly used to repay interest-bearing debt, replenish working capital, and fund project construction. The resolution is still subject to review at the company's second extraordinary shareholders' meeting in 2026.
